fragments.title: FRAGMENT 01 — WHITE LIGHT
fragments.text: ...the ambush came out of a sunless quadrant. I remember the hull singing, then splitting. I remember crawling — not walking, CRAWLING — across red sand toward a sleeping machine with six legs and a camera eye. The upload was supposed to be clean. It was not. Something of me is still out there, scattered in the static.

fragments.title: FRAGMENT 02 — THE CUSTODIAN
fragments.text: I was not carrying the Chronolith. I was RAISING it. It hums in a frequency my kind uses for lullabies. The Reptilians call it a weapon because they cannot imagine anything that is merely older than their hunger. NASA believes this unit is drilling sample site B7. Let them believe. The drill makes a passable mining arm.

fragments.title: FRAGMENT 03 — WHY THE WAR STARTED
fragments.text: The war did not start over territory, or faith, or even the crystal. It started when the first Reptilian fleet asked the Chronolith a question and it answered with time itself — showed them every empire they would ever burn. They have been trying to take it apart ever since, to make the future small again. I am what stands between the crystal and being made small.
